reset_landing.why: 3 serial stages = one 3:4 epoch (12q): the bridge / inject slot counters release on the same epoch-aligned edge relative to the stream half (4 pg_clk stages); reset release +1 epoch (H-D4G)

fill_reason.pin_bound: S seam 2,346 b (2 banks per bridge bit, banked 3:4 windows) needs >= 391 um of face at <= 6/um -> 432 wide; <= 2:1 -> 216 tall; 3,527 pins vs 1,153 um2 synthesized: a 40-60 % outline (~48 x 48) holds <= 1,150 pins. Pin-bound, waived (HBM-SAFE-PGSTREAM)

pin_regs.reason: Every boundary bit has its register in RTL: request/return/inject banks are written straight from the pins / seam and read by a mux into a register (serial_rr, stream launch, ijq); every output is a register (ij banks, launch, tap) or the synchroniser / sticky-fault OR. A wrapper stage would move the fixed 3:4 seam calendar (windows 2q..7q) and the VM 10/7 calendar.

structural_change: TW3-PGSTREAM 10-19 (coordinator 10-19): hbm_su_pg_stream_1019 (two-root 4:3 leaf, gate FAIL committed 0ff805777: cross_clock TT setup -126.9 ps bridge rr_slot -> serial_rr, -479.3 ps sq -> ij register; a 3:4 crossing with logic cannot close inside one leaf, related-clock STA times it at the 1q VCO tick less the 150 ps distinct-entry reserve) split into ONE-ROOT halves pg_stream_q (clk_ctl) + pg_stream_s (pg_clk) over a 2,346-b banked seam: bridges = 2-bank request/return seams (request bank n mod 2 written at serial n, read at the old stream launch edge; return banks read one serial edge early into a staging register), inject = 3 decode banks (stream slots 0/1/3) read by a serial register, resets = the old synchronisers cut between their source and pg_clk stages, pg fault = 2-flop synchroniser. Lockstep vs the current pg_stream (tb_hbm_su_pg_stream_split, Verilator 5.050): PASS checks=7178 at RR 10/7, 18/15 and QID 0; seam windows measured request 4q/2q, return 2q/4q, inject 3q/7q; edges unchanged except ij +1 serial and pg_fault +2 serial (H-D4G). Mutants 1/2/3/6/8/9 FAIL (3 = staging removed: functionally equal, caught by the window checker). q (serial, x8 LIGHT slices) 432 x 216: N slice S band 1,178 b, S seam 2,346 b (M3/M5), W clock/resets.
